definition.DNP: No participation/void probability. No DNP-toUnder or missing-stat-tozero.
definition.played_proxy: Any observed PHYSICAL statistic >0 OR any passing/rushing/receiving yard value !=0; null is converted to0 only inside this positive-evidence test, not into target labels.
definition.population_warning: Historical pool explicitly STAT_ROW_CONDITIONED_RECONSTRUCTION_NOT_PREGAME_ROSTER. Not complete actual on-field participation or all zero-event participants.
definition.query: Native identities without a stat row get all target labels unknown. Pregame current queries can legitimately have no target outcome.
definition.target_label_admission: Final game score present AND played_proxy AND actual receptions is a valid explicitly present nonnegative integer. Missing/invalid target remainsNone.
definition.training: 2022+ REG, available=kickoff+7days strictly before weekly origin; nonnull target only. Query-only native missing-stat additions excluded from training.

expiry_policy: min(observed roster publication+36hours,final native status observed+30minutes,kickoff-5minutes); exact clocks/source rights/finality verified by website owner; no inferred or backdated time
label: Appearance-conditioned mean
scope: Numeric-only current packet or honest shadow. No probability, participation guarantee, strict/margin recommendation, Top Picks or new primary promotion.
